blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – Mandaue City is stepping up preparations for All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day on Nov. 1 and 2, with various city offices and concerned agencies implementing measures to ensure public safety and the orderly observance of the holidays. Buddy Alain Ybañez, head of the City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO), said in an interview on Thursday, Oct. 15, that preparations include emergency response, public safety, fire prevention, medical assistance and traffic management, with the participation of the Mandaue City Police Office (MCPO), Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP), Traffic Enforcement Agency of Mandaue (TEAM), concerned […]...
